cases.sentence: Среди рожденных женами еще не было ___ более великого, чем Иоанн Креститель.
cases.translation: Among those born of women there has not arisen anyone greater than John the Baptist.
cases.explain: The negated existential не было governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Ты, утаив от мудрецов и ученых, открыл это ___.
cases.translation: You, hiding it from the wise and learned, revealed it to infants.
cases.explain: The verb открыл (revealed to) takes its recipient in the dative case.

cases.sentence: Тогда что же вы ходили смотреть? ___.
cases.translation: Then what did you go out to see? A prophet.
cases.explain: The verb смотреть (to go see) takes a direct object in the accusative case; пророк is animate, so its accusative matches the genitive form.

cases.sentence: Говорю вам истину, среди рожденных ___ еще не было человека более великого, чем Иоанн Креститель.
cases.translation: I tell you the truth, among those born of women there has not been anyone greater than John the Baptist.
cases.explain: Instrumental expresses the agent 'born of women' without a preposition.

cases.sentence: Когда Иоанн, находясь в ___, услышал о том, что делает Христос, он послал своих учеников спросить его.
cases.translation: When John, being in prison, heard what Christ was doing, he sent his disciples to ask him.
cases.explain: The preposition в indicating location takes the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Со дней Иоанна Крестителя и до ныне ___ Божие стремительно продвигается вперед.
cases.translation: From the days of John the Baptist until now, the kingdom of God has been advancing forcefully.
cases.explain: Царство is the grammatical subject of the verb продвигается, so it stands in the nominative case.

reading.ru: Ты ли тот, кто должен прийти? Или нам ожидать кого-то другого?
reading.question: What question did John's disciples ask Jesus?
options: Whether he was the one who was to come, or should they wait for another
Whether he would forgive their sins
Whether he would free John from prison
reading.correct: Whether he was the one who was to come, or should they wait for another
reading.explain: John sends disciples to ask Ты ли тот, кто должен прийти? Или нам ожидать кого-то другого?

reading.ru: Слепые прозревают, хромые ходят, прокаженные очищаются, глухие слышат, мертвые воскресают, и бедным возвещается радостная весть
reading.question: What evidence did Jesus give John's disciples of his identity?
options: The blind see, the lame walk, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, and good news is preached to the poor
He recited the entire Law of Moses
He performed a public miracle before a crowd of priests
He showed them a written prophecy
reading.correct: The blind see, the lame walk, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, and good news is preached to the poor
reading.explain: Jesus lists these signs as proof of who he is.

reading.ru: Говорю вам истину, среди рожденных женами еще не было человека более великого, чем Иоанн Креститель, но наименьший в Царстве Небесном больше его
reading.question: What did Jesus say about John the Baptist's greatness?
options: No one born of women was greater, yet the least in heaven's kingdom is greater than him
John was the greatest king in Israel's history
John was greater than the Son of Man
reading.correct: No one born of women was greater, yet the least in heaven's kingdom is greater than him
reading.explain: Jesus says none born of women is greater than John, but наименьший в Царстве Небесном больше его.

reading.ru: Мы играли вам на свирели, а вы не плясали. Мы пели вам похоронные песни, а вы не печалились.
reading.question: What complaint does Jesus attribute to 'this generation' about their reaction to others?
options: They neither danced to the flute nor mourned at funeral songs
They danced too much at weddings
They refused to listen to any music
They complained about the price of food
reading.correct: They neither danced to the flute nor mourned at funeral songs
reading.explain: The children's complaint describes people who would not dance to the flute or mourn at funeral songs.

reading.ru: Горе тебе, Хоразин! Горе тебе, Вифсаида!
reading.question: Which cities did Jesus pronounce 'woe' upon for not repenting?
reading.explain: Jesus says Горе тебе, Хоразин! Горе тебе, Вифсаида!

reading.ru: Я славлю тебя, Отец, Господь неба и земли, за то, что ты, утаив от мудрецов и ученых, открыл это младенцам.
reading.question: To whom did the Father reveal these things, according to Jesus' prayer?
options: To infants/little children, rather than the wise and learned
reading.correct: To infants/little children, rather than the wise and learned
reading.explain: Jesus thanks the Father for hiding things from the wise and revealing them to младенцам (infants).

reading.ru: Придите ко мне, все уставшие и обремененные, и я успокою вас.
reading.question: Who does Jesus invite to come to him?
options: All who are weary and burdened
reading.correct: All who are weary and burdened
reading.explain: Jesus invites все уставшие и обремененные (all who are weary and burdened).

reading.ru: Возьмите на себя ермо мое и научитесь у меня, потому что я кроток и мягок сердцем, и вы найдете покой вашим душам
reading.question: What does Jesus say his followers will find if they learn from him?
reading.explain: Jesus promises вы найдете покой вашим душам (you will find rest for your souls).
